turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
Why am I here, Hale? What happened with Owen's essay?
Be honest. On a scale of one to ten, how am I doing in this meeting?
I'm not grading you. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
And what's one thing I could do better?
That's not my job. What do you have on Owen's essay?
